chunks: Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Yahya, from Ibrahim, from Muhammad ibn Umar al-Zayyat, from Jamil ibn Darrāj, who said:

I asked Abā al-Ḥasan al-Awwal عليه السلام about making up salat al-layl after fajr until sunrise. He said: Yes, and after al-'asr until the night; for it is among the hidden secrets of the family of Muhammad.

key_terms.آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ: the family of Muhammad صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم
key_terms.الْعَصْرِ: the afternoon prayer time after which qada' is also permitted here
key_terms.الْفَجْرِ: dawn, marking the beginning of the fajr prayer time
key_terms.صَلَاةِ اللَّيْلِ: the night prayer performed as a recommended devotional act
key_terms.طُلُوعِ الشَّمْسِ: sunrise, the limit mentioned for one time of making up the prayer
key_terms.قَضَاءِ: making up a missed act of worship

ai.seo_question: When can qada' of salat al-layl be performed according to Imam al-Kazim عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith states that the missed salat al-layl may be made up after fajr until sunrise, and also after al-'asr until the onset of night. It presents this ruling as a preserved teaching from the family of Muhammad صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم.
